hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
#!/usr/bin/env bash set -euo pipefail
LOG_TS() { date +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S%z"; } log() { echo "[$(LOG_TS)] INFO $*" >&2; } warn() { echo "[$(LOG_TS)] WARN $*" >&2; } error() { echo "[$(LOG_TS)] ERROR $*" >&2; }
need() { command -v "$1" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { error "Missing required command: $1"; exit 2; }; }
cleanup() { local rc=$? local cmd="${BASH_COMMAND:-}" local line="${BASH_LINENO[0]:-}"
if [[ $rc -eq 0 ]]; then log "EXIT rc=0 (success). Cleaning AWS env vars." else error "EXIT rc=${rc} at line=${line} cmd=${cmd}. Cleaning AWS env vars." fi
unset AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY AWS_SESSION_TOKEN
# show some useful tails if present if [[ -d logs ]]; then local any_log any_log="$(ls -1 logs/*.log 2>/dev/null | head -n 1 || true)" if [[ -n "$any_log" ]]; then warn "Last 20 lines of the most recent log: $(ls -1t logs/*.log 2>/dev/null | head -n 1)" tail -n 20 "$(ls -1t logs/*.log 2>/dev/null | head -n 1)" >&2 || true fi fi } on_err() { local rc=$? local line="${BASH_LINENO[0]:-}" local cmd="${BASH_COMMAND:-}" error "ERR rc=${rc} at line=${line} cmd=${cmd}" return $rc } trap on_err ERR trap cleanup EXIT
assume_role() { local role_arn="${ROLE_ARN:-arn:aws:iam::736265540791:role/dbgap-etl}" local session_name="${ROLE_SESSION_NAME:-s3-test}" local duration="${ASSUME_DURATION_SECONDS:-3600}"
log "Assuming role ${role_arn} (duration=${duration}s)" local assume_json assume_json="$(mktemp)"
aws sts assume-role \ --duration-seconds "$duration" \ --role-arn "$role_arn" \ --role-session-name "$session_name" \ > "$assume_json"
export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY AWS_SESSION_TOKEN AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID="$(jq -r '.Credentials.AccessKeyId' "$assume_json")" AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY="$(jq -r '.Credentials.SecretAccessKey' "$assume_json")" AWS_SESSION_TOKEN="$(jq -r '.Credentials.SessionToken' "$assume_json")" rm -f "$assume_json"
log "Role assumed" }
reset_dir() { local d="$1" rm -rf "$d" mkdir -p "$d" }
# optional-safe S3 cp (won't kill job unless required=true) s3_cp() { # Usage: s3_cp <src> <dst> <required:true|false> local src="$1" dst="$2" required="${3:-true}" if aws s3 cp "$src" "$dst" --no-progress --only-show-errors; then return 0 fi if [[ "$required" == "true" ]]; then error "S3 copy failed (required): $src -> $dst" return 1 fi warn "S3 copy failed (optional): $src -> $dst" return 0 }
# ----------------------------- # Prereqs + required inputs # ----------------------------- need aws need jq need csvcut need csvformat need tail need sed need java
: "${managed_inputs:?managed_inputs must be set (s3://.../Managed_Inputs.csv)}" S3_BUCKET="${S3_BUCKET:-avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl}"
# ----------------------------- # Workspace dirs # ----------------------------- reset_dir data reset_dir completed reset_dir hierarchies reset_dir processing reset_dir logs rm -rf pic-sure-hpds/ || true
# ----------------------------- # Pull managed inputs (once) # ----------------------------- assume_role log "Downloading managed inputs: ${managed_inputs} -> ./Managed_Inputs.csv" s3_cp "$managed_inputs" "./Managed_Inputs.csv" true
log "Building inputs.csv" csvcut -c "Study Abbreviated Name","Study Identifier","Study Type","Data is ready to process","Data Processed","Has Multi","Use Manual Table Methods" \ "Managed_Inputs.csv" > "inputs.csv"
log "inputs.csv preview:" head -n 10 inputs.csv >&2 || true
# ----------------------------- # Iterate studies (parse safely) # ----------------------------- should_skip_type() { local t="${1,,}" [[ "$t" == "parent" || "$t" == "topmed" || "$t" == "substudy" || "$t" == "compliant" || "$t" == "imaging" || "$t" != "biolincc" || "$t" == "other" ]] }
process_study() { local abv_name="$1" stdy_id="$2" stdy_type="$3" data_ready="$4" data_processed="$5" has_multi="$6" has_tables="$7"
if [[ "${data_ready,,}" != "yes" || "${data_processed,,}" != "no" ]]; then log "${abv_name} ${stdy_id}: not ready and/or already processed; skipping" return 0 fi
if should_skip_type "$stdy_type"; then log "${abv_name} ${stdy_id}: type=${stdy_type} excluded; skipping" return 0 fi
local abv_lc abv_uc abv_lc="$(printf '%s' "$abv_name" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')" abv_uc="$(printf '%s' "$abv_name" | tr '[:lower:]' '[:upper:]')"
log "Processing ${abv_name} ${stdy_id} (type=${stdy_type}, multi=${has_multi}, tables=${has_tables})"
# per-study clean (avoid sed touching prior study files) rm -rf data/* completed/* hierarchies/* processing/* || true
# ---- download study files ---- # Decoded CSVs (required) aws s3 cp "s3://${S3_BUCKET}/${abv_lc}/decoded_data/" "data/" \ --recursive --exclude "*" --include "*.csv" \ --no-progress --only-show-errors \ || { error "Failed: decoded_data/*.csv for ${abv_name} ${stdy_id}"; return 1; }
aws s3 cp "s3://${S3_BUCKET}/${abv_lc}/decoded_data/" "data/" \ --recursive --exclude "*" --include "*.txt" \ --no-progress --only-show-errors \ || { error "Failed: decoded_data/*.csv for ${abv_name} ${stdy_id}"; return 1; }
# Metadata JSON (try rawData first, then decoded_data as fallback) local meta_name="${stdy_id}_${abv_lc}_metadata.json" local meta_dst="data/${meta_name}"
s3_cp "s3://${S3_BUCKET}/${abv_lc}/rawData/${meta_name}" "$meta_dst" false if [[ ! -s "$meta_dst" ]]; then s3_cp "s3://${S3_BUCKET}/${abv_lc}/decoded_data/${meta_name}" "$meta_dst" false fi if [[ ! -s "$meta_dst" ]]; then error "Missing required metadata json for ${abv_name} ${stdy_id}: ${meta_name}" return 1 fi
# Remove UTF-8 BOM only from files we own in data/ # (safe with pipefail; grep returns 1 when no matches, so avoid it) for f in data/*; do [[ -f "$f" ]] || continue sed -i '1s/^\xEF\xBB\xBF//' "$f" || true done
# ---- mapping gen 1 ---- if [[ "${has_tables,,}" == "yes" ]]; then log "GenericMappingGenerator: datatables enabled (${stdy_id})" java -jar jars/GenericMappingGenerator.jar \ -trialid "$stdy_id" \ -hasDataTables \ -metadataFile "$meta_dst" \ > "logs/${stdy_id}_mapping_gen1.log" else log "GenericMappingGenerator: datatables disabled (${stdy_id})" java -jar jars/GenericMappingGenerator.jar \ -trialid "$stdy_id" \ > "logs/${stdy_id}_mapping_gen1.log" fi
# Ensure expected output exists if [[ ! -s "completed/${stdy_id}_mapping.csv" ]]; then error "Expected output missing/empty: completed/${stdy_id}_mapping.csv" return 1 fi
# ---- optional multi step ---- #if [[ "${has_multi,,}" == "yes" ]]; then # log "Multi enabled: pulling rawData ${stdy_id}*" # aws s3 cp "s3://${S3_BUCKET}/${abv_lc}/rawData/" "data/" \ # --recursive --exclude "*" --include "${stdy_id}*" \ # --no-progress --only-show-errors \ # || { error "Failed: rawData/${stdy_id}* for ${abv_name} ${stdy_id}"; return 1; } # # log "DbgapTreeBuilder3 (${stdy_id})" # java -jar jars/DbgapTreeBuilder3.jar -trialid "$stdy_id" \ # > "logs/${stdy_id}_mapping_gen2.log" # # if [[ -s "completed/${stdy_id}_mapping2.csv" ]]; then # cat "completed/${stdy_id}_mapping2.csv" >> "completed/${stdy_id}_mapping.csv" # else # warn "Multi run produced no completed/${stdy_id}_mapping2.csv; continuing"
#fi # fi
# ---- upload result ---- local dst="s3://${S3_BUCKET}/${abv_lc}/mappings/${stdy_id}/mapping2.csv" log "Uploading completed/${stdy_id}_mapping.csv -> ${dst}" aws s3 cp "completed/${stdy_id}_mapping.csv" "$dst" --no-progress --only-show-errors
log "Done ${abv_name} ${stdy_id}" }
# Use csvformat to normalize quotes; skip header safely tail -n +2 inputs.csv \ | csvformat -U 1 \ | while IFS=',' read -r abv_name stdy_id stdy_type data_ready data_processed has_multi has_tables; do # Trim possible quotes/spaces abv_name="${abv_name%\"}"; abv_name="${abv_name#\"}" stdy_id="${stdy_id%\"}"; stdy_id="${stdy_id#\"}" stdy_type="${stdy_type%\"}"; stdy_type="${stdy_type#\"}" data_ready="${data_ready%\"}"; data_ready="${data_ready#\"}" data_processed="${data_processed%\"}"; data_processed="${data_processed#\"}" has_multi="${has_multi%\"}"; has_multi="${has_multi#\"}" has_tables="${has_tables%\"}"; has_tables="${has_tables#\"}"
process_study "$abv_name" "$stdy_id" "$stdy_type" "$data_ready" "$data_processed" "$has_multi" "$has_tables" done
log "All studies processed"
